cornerstone.holders: BPV and HTCI (in connection with Huatai Back-to-back TRS and Huatai Client TRS); Tencent Holdings; Huang River; Prosper High; LAV Entities; LAV Star; LAV Star Opportunities; Foresight; GSC Fund 1; Vision Fund 1; Horizon Fund 1; Horizon Next Fund; First Quarter Moon OFC – Phecda Fund; WWHCP
cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries, entities under the same management or control (as the case maybe) who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; restricted period inclusive of Listing Date, exclusive of the six-month anniversary

controller_6m.notes: No Rule 10.07(1)(a) controlling-shareholder undertaking found. Searched “10.07” (only incidental hits: a 10.07% table figure on page 287 and Rule 19A.13A public-float text on page 144), “Undertakings by the Controlling Shareholders”, “Controlling Shareholders have undertaken”, “procure that the relevant registered holder” — none. The Underwriting undertakings section (pages 299-300) contains only the Company's Rule 10.08 undertaking and Company-only Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertakings, despite the prospectus referencing “the Controlling Shareholders” elsewhere (e.g. page 284).

controller_12m.notes: Same: no 10.07(1)(b) control undertaking. Closest provisions are PRC Company Law statutory restrictions on ALL pre-Global Offering Shares: “within the 12 months following the Listing Date, Shares issued by the Company prior to the Global Offering (including those held by the Pre-IPO Investors at the time of the Global Offering) are restricted from trading” (page 137) and “our Shares issued prior to the Listing shall not be transferred within one year from the Listing Date” (page 269) — these are not Rule 10.07(1)(b) controlling-shareholder undertakings.
